claims.head: Boeser’s line gets the soft minutes
claims.call: The Canucks’ L1 (Cotter, Chytil and Boeser) spends at least 48% of its 5-on-5 time against the Red Wings’ second line.
claims.body: At home, the Canucks keep sending Boeser’s line (Cotter, Chytil and Boeser) out against opponents’ second lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Manny Malhotra has been chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Red Wings’ second line is Brandsegg-Nygård, Finnie and DeBrincat.
claims.nums: At home: 48% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against second lines, about 25% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Manny Malhotra likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Red Wings’ second line.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 7 of their last 9 games, including the last one. Lucas Raymond takes shifts on two lines, L1 and L4. Axel Sandin-Pellikka is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Faulk and Englund.
J.T. Compher has not dressed for the last 7 games.
Simon Edvinsson has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Ben Chiarot has taken his spot beside Moritz Seider.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 6th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 41%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Marco Rossi is day to day (illness) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward.
Max Sasson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 34% of the team’s shorthanded time in 11 games, up from 4% last season.

VAN.head: The Canucks face a real test
VAN.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ best way through is getting good looks.

DET.head: The matchup suits the Red Wings
DET.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ way back in is getting good looks.

story.head: The Canucks need a win
paras: The Canucks are winless in eight (0-7-1). The Red Wings are 3-3-3.
At home, Manny Malhotra likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Red Wings’ second line. The Wings’ power play has a soft target in the Canucks’ kill.

items.text: The Red Wings are newly without Daniil Tarasov, have been without J.T. Compher since Oct 4, and have had to make do without Simon Edvinsson all season. John Gibson is expected to start.
Jake DeBrusk has six goals in eight games against Detroit since 2023-24.
Marco Rossi has missed the Canucks’ last two games.
The Canucks have been without Thatcher Demko all season. Kevin Lankinen is expected to start.
